intro: Can you read an empty room?
description:
What if the quietest scene held the biggest clue?

You know that feeling when something looks normal… until it suddenly doesn’t.

This is a casual picture puzzle game where each round shows one illustration and one prompt. Study the scene, compare the details, and choose the single spot that answers the question.

・Read the prompt
・Check the illustration carefully
・Choose the one place that fits

Every stage is quick to play, but the right answer may be tucked among similar-looking details. Trust your eyes, take a closer look, and enjoy that little aha moment when the room finally gives itself away.

Ready to uncover the truth hiding in plain sight?
